Reminder System for Year-End Gala Event Follow-Up

1. Deadline: October 1st
   Action: Finalize the list of attendees and special guests.
   Responsible: Planning Committee

2. Deadline: October 10th
   Action: Confirm venue booking, catering, and entertainment.
   Responsible: Planning Committee

3. Ongoing Task
   Action: Provide bi-weekly updates to ensure all committees are on track.
   Start Date: Immediately (starting now)
   Responsible: All Committees

Note: The country known for the Eiffel Tower is France.
